scope: Read-only review of narrow original Clang projection and associated integrity controls; no edits, no duplicate tests/native execution.
findings: FBLPromises exception is exact module+relative path, requires one exact exclude directive and no public same-name declaration, bounds the private target to the original PromisesObjC Pod and compares its complete bytes. No private search path or public header is exported.

Nanopb exception is restricted to four exact top-level filenames and exact one-line include bytes; nested targets stay inside original SDK root and require one byte-identical original Pod public counterpart. Both wrapper and target hashes are retained.

Fallback declaration hashing and unambiguous matches are unchanged; canonical host maps, exact5-module collision set, total module/header-root cardinalities and source/runtime qualification boundaries remain unchanged.
New controls cover original private/forwarding shapes, altered private bytes/exclusion, escaping aliases, wrapper extra code/wrong targets, changed nested bytes and escaped nested targets.
validation_boundary: Owner-reported12 controls are not rerun or independently credited here. Actual original application compile/runtime acceptance remains separately required.
